messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Incident 2024-INC-089: api-degradation - increased p95/5xx in eu-west-1. Paging oncall @alex. link: https://rbw.in/incident/2024-INC-089
alex: acked, joining bridge now
jamal: i'm on my way, grabbing logs. which customer signals showed impact?
maya: BrightHire reported timeouts, and we saw an internal regression in prefix cache that spiked p95 from 120ms -> 2.1s
sophie: started a quick mitigation: disabled a risky rollout replica group, traffic shifted to stable pool. p95 dropping.
alex: thanks. contain step applied at 10:44 UTC. still seeing occasional 5xx but much lower.
product-ops: flagged 3 customers as potentially impacted (BrightHire, Papertrail, Sparkloop). advising comms.
jamal: dumping kv-cache metrics: eviction rate 5x baseline, lots of small seqs hitting cold-paths.
alex: handoff: i'm going offline for 20m. @jamal take the bridge, @maya you'll own customer comms.
jamal: got it, taking the bridge. creating a short action tracker now.
alex: note: no PII exfil, logs show internal throttles only. good to call containment complete.
incident-bot: [RECOVERY] 2024-INC-089 marked contained at 10:59 UTC by alex
maya: thanks. Bumping to post-incident review. propose async retro + 1h live postmortem tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
product-ops: works for customers, we'll prep comms. shared status page update sent.
sophie: immediate followups we should track:
- OBS-1128: add eviction-rate alert (current: only p95/5xx) -> owner: jamal -> eta: 3d
- INF-2041: rollback/traffic-shift runbook patch for replica rollouts -> owner: alex -> eta: 1d
- MTR-900: add noisy-caller suppression window to paging rules for KV cache evictions -> owner: sophie -> eta: 5d
jamal: small tweak: make eviction alert a soft-page first (pager only at sustained > x for 5m), post oncall noise sweep
maya: add customer follow-up ticket CUST-321 -> owner: maya -> eta: today COB
alex: also add postmortem doc skeleton: https://rbw.in/pm/2024-INC-089
product-ops: scheduling note: we'll collect timeline + evidence in doc, then sync tomorrow for 30m to finalize action owners.
jamal: opened OBS-1128, INF-2041, CUST-321, linked in the incident doc.
alex: on SLOs and alerts: proposal from eng-sre meeting: shift paging for infra signals to two-tier alerts:
1) visible alert (Slack) for ops; no page
2) page if visible alert persists > 5m or if accompanying client-facing errors > 0.1% of traffic
jamal: sounds good. reduces noise but keeps escalation guarantee.
sophie: another suggestion: decompose the big 'api-degradation' alert into signal-specific alerts (evictions, kv-colddrops, 5xx uplink) so we can route to the right owner.
maya: agree. product-ops will draft updated routing matrix.
alex: quick checklist for postmortem doc before the meeting:
- timeline (who did what, exact timestamps)
- customer impact + comms timeline
- root cause analysis
- action items (owner + ETA)
- SLO/alert change proposal
- follow-up validation plan (how we'll measure success)
product-ops: i've added that checklist to the doc.
oncall-rotation-bot: note: alex -> jamal handoff recorded at 10:44 UTC
jamal: closing bridge, marking incident resolved in pager duty. I'll run the noise-sweep next week with oncall team.
alex: thanks all. will post the final meeting invite and add the runbook link. Good job on quick containment. :trophy:
maya: leaving this thread with the customer comms draft in the doc.
sophie: action recap (short): OBS-1128 jamal 3d; INF-2041 alex 1d; CUST-321 maya today; RUN-745 runbook edits sophie 5d; ALERT-MAP product-ops 2d
alex: leaving a note: add a synthetic to detect cold-path kv reads at 95th percentile to validate fixes -> owner: jamal -> eta: 7d
jamal: acknowledged.
product-ops: meeting invite sent for 14:00 UTC tomorrow, async notes due by 12:00 UTC.
incident-bot: thread closed for live updates. please update the incident doc for postmortem.
